I highly recommend Pongsakorn Dental Clinic!

Best all around dentist that’s gentle on teeth cleaning and doesn’t upsell unnecessary work.

Yes, I’m one of these people, who gets very nervous around getting things done on my teeth. I’ve received two teeth cleaning done by Dr.Pongsakorn. I don’t know how the Dr does it, but I didn’t need my gums numbed for him to clean my teeth. He also has lovely bedside manners. And is easily the most affordable death cleaning around old city. (700 baht). I have my husband going to him now as well.

I had to get a crown whilst on holiday in Chiang Mai. I found Dr Pongsakorn's dental clinic and walked in off the street. I explained my problem and he took me in straight away as he had a spare appointment.  He x-rayed my teeth and took me into his clinic and showed me the issue causing the problem on the x-ray screen.  He discussed in perfect English 2 methods of treatment, outlining his preferred method and why. This was in fact the easier and less expensive route.  I was booked in for treatment 2 days later.  I had impressions taken, a temporary crown fitted and a repair made to another tooth which was sitting next to the proposed crown. The appointment was booked for 2 hours and the treatment was first class, no pain whatsoever.  I was booked in for a further appointment 2 days later when the zirconium crown was to be fitted. After much attention Dr Pongsakorn was not happy with it's fit, although I thought it was fine. He apologised but said he wasn't happy and could I come back in 2 days.

On the next appointment the crown was fitted, he showed me before it was fitted, it looked totally amazing. After fitting this time he was satisfied. I'm more than pleased. I asked to have my teeth cleaned also. Which I must say was second to none!

In short, this man is a genius, his staff are so kind and friendly. I have never received such dedicated treatment anywhere. The treatment I had was probably one third of what I would have paid in the UK.  I most certainly will be back to get more work done. His attention to detail is excellent!
A very professional and skilled dentist who worked with a small and competent team. I was very comfortable with the process and highly recommend his work.

This is truly a hidden gem of a dental clinic! 💖 I'm so lucky and grateful to have found Dr. Pongsakorn ✨

I had my teeth whitened, a two-hour procedure. The doctor and nurses were very professional, and the dentist cleaned my teeth very thoroughly. I'm extremely satisfied with the results! The stains are gone! My teeth are noticeably whiter! I'm so happy!

Before this, I consulted with six clinics in the old city, and Pongsakorn offered the best price, including a cleaning! 👍 (Other clinics charged an extra 800-1200 baht for cleaning).

The dentist can communicate in English, making the entire procedure very smooth. He's also very honest and straightforward, without any sales pitches. He explained to me that the difference between different whitening treatments lies only in the intensity of the light; the gel itself is the same. This dentist uses medium concentration light, which was perfect for my first whitening experience! 👍

Amazing dentist! Gentle, professional & speaks perfect English:) Prices are given up front, unlike many others around town that give you a huge range 800 - 2000 (depending on how they feel I guess?) for cleaning.
700 baht for cleaning here & I will for sure be returning for further dental work, highly recommend!
One of the best doctors I’ve visited. Honest, straightforward, and truly dedicated — not driven by money but by genuine service and care. I highly recommend this dental clinic. 👍🏻 …
I received immediate and excellent care from Dr. Pongsakorn when my inlay came out unexpectedly. Very professional, friendly, and helpful advice. Highly recommended.

My husband and I have been visiting Pongsakorn regularly for the past few years. The dental service he has provided to us has always been to a very high standard. We have no hesitation in recommending this top quality dental practice
I went for a cleaning, very good service.
I went for whitening teeth treatment and dentist is Pure magician! He whitened my teeth for few shades. 10/10 would recommend this clinic.

Went to this clinic just by chance for simple consultation. I was little afraid to go in the vacation.

I am glad I went. Doctor thoroughly explained my issue in detail and suggested for cleaning.

Cleaning took around 20-25 minutes and it was very painless.

And I didn't feel any pain post cleaning.

Finally, the price is also cheaper than atleast nearby clinics.
Great dentist. Really good at explaining things

I've had my teeth cleaned at several places, but this one is excellent. The dentist was very thorough, and my teeth are incredibly clean. I used my social security insurance, so there were no extra charges.

My tooth chipped and I came here to bond/seal it to prevent it from being damaged further. I am so glad I did.

I got a resin filling, a manual exam for any cavities, and a dental cleaning (700 THB). All together 1400 THB. Totally worth it!

I am glad I did it here versus back in Canada. I wouldn’t be able to afford this dental treatment back in Canada, so I’m glad I was able to receive quality treatment at affordable price here in Chiang Mai.

It is not a fancy clinic, but the pricing and treatment was great! Thank you Doctor Pongsakorn.

The dentist was fantastic-he spoke perfect English, which made everything so easy, and completed the extraction quickly and painlessly. The cost was very fair, and I feel confident about continuing my dental care here in the future. A genuinely great find in Chiang Mai!

Just as good or better than any cleaning I've had back home. Very clean and professional. I would return for all my dental needs.
